description: Assemble 2-12 uploaded photos into a video, each shown exactly once in supplied order. Enforces targetSeconds (5-60), music and text switches. Defaults to a silent, text-free reel. This uses the normal video renderer, not a trend sound. Returns rendering status, not a finished video. Branded text uses the renderer's saved brand settings; do not promise separate fonts per heading/subheading/body or a monochrome filter. Existing photos are preserved. Do not change account defaults.
name: create_photo_reel
